Field Descriptions

arprot_requirement

When read_filter_enable is set, only allow read accesses with this prot value

awprot_requirement

When write_filter_enable is set, only allow write accesses with this prot value

read_filter_enable

Filter Value - the value that must be written to the filter register to allow access to the GPIO register interface.

write_filter_enable

Filter Enable - when set, only SEP may access the GPIO register interface. This effectivley makes the GPIO a SEP-only interface.
